title: AI Research Scientist
summary: AI research scientists invent and test new machine learning methods, such as better ways to train language or vision models, and publish what they find as papers. They sit in a research lab or a central AI team, often with a PhD, and hand their best ideas to engineers who put them into products.
dailyDuties: Read new papers and pick research ideas to try
Design and run training experiments on GPU clusters
Write research code in PyTorch or JAX
Build benchmarks and compare results with statistics
Write papers and internal reports on findings
Present results in lab reading groups
Help engineers move a working method into a product

skills.expectation: Know the theory behind ML methods well enough to invent new ones
Design and train new neural network architectures
Write research code and run experiments in PyTorch or JAX
Write clean Python for experiments, data loading and evaluation
Use probability and statistics to compare results fairly
Publish papers at top ML conferences or journals
Do research in language or speech models
Do research in vision or multimodal models
Pre-train or post-train large models across many GPUs
Build on open transformer models and datasets
Build benchmarks and evaluations for new models
Write or tune GPU kernels for faster training
Share research code in version control
